resources.string: Your Voice. Your World. Your ZIA.
ZIA AI uses the microphone only when you press Push-to-Talk to convert your speech into text commands. Nothing is recorded in the background.

All assistant memory, reminders, and chat history stay locally on your phone by default. Passwords, OTPs, and sensitive tokens are automatically blocked from memory. Cloud AI requests are sent only when online and when Cloud AI Consent is enabled.
